explanation: The theorem says the library's own GLBPrimeCore (defined as relPPrimeCore, a sSup of normal subgroups of H with order coprime to p) commutes with a group automorphism. I looked up the two definitions and did not search Mathlib's sources. As far as I know, Mathlib has no p'-core or relative p'-core definition, and so no lemma about it. Its general lemmas about Subgroup.map and sSup don't carry this content, which comes from the library's own definition. The proof is a custom argument: it combines a one-sided inclusion lemma with the inverse automorphism.
